description: Land Acquisition - Natthambura, Hewadiwela and Kaadawatta, Rambukkana D/S Division Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and survey references. The content primarily deals with land matters (acquisition, property descriptions, boundaries) and falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
